items.title: Melba Liston — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Oh yeah. He and Minnie both dead, huh?

ctx.x: I didn’t know that. [Liston and Bryant identify, in this photograph, Minnie Hightower, her mother Miss Hightower, Vi Redd, Liston. They fail to identify a man in the photograph. Liston thinks it is Robert Ross, but Bryant pulls out a photo of a different man whom she identifies as Ross.]
Oh yeah. He and Minnie both dead, huh?
